owner_and_capability: School Structure: retire models/education (#3556). The School Structure values move to modules/schoolstructure/internal/domain without an ORM mapping; the legacy composition names them through modules/schoolstructure/compose aliases; values of another owner's table stay with that owner (the Workforce group substitution row) or the consumer (the notification recipients' staff-group pair).
atomic_cutover: One code-only change. models/education is deleted with its policy package entry. Group, GroupRoom, GroupListQuery, StaffGroupID, GroupTeacher, ClassTeacher, GroupSubstitution, the substitution staff and person, Teacher, Caregiver, HandoverQuery, SchoolClassChange, SubstitutionChange and ErrHandoverExists move to modules/schoolstructure/internal/domain without bun tags; the existing domain.Group gains the room projection and the name validation; the store failure and missing-row shapes become domain.StoreError and domain.RecordNotFound with the same text and markers. The retained group store maps education.groups through a private groupRow. The grade transition lock key becomes schoolstructure.TransitionsLockKey; the unused setters, Duration, HasRoom, the substitution Validate, the tenant accessors and the grade transition rows (only fixtures wrote them) are deleted. database/repositories, services and api/testutil name the values through modules/schoolstructure/compose aliases. The Workforce adapter in modules/workforce/legacy serves its own GroupSubstitution row and names groups through a GroupNames lookup; the relations of the reads with relations (School Structure group, School Membership staff) are attached by the legacy root's groupSubstitutions decorator, and EducationHandovers translates the rows into School Structure values for the substitution module and the group service's deletion guard. The staff recipient resolver declares its own GroupSupervisors port and StaffGroupPair, bound by services.notificationGroupSupervisors. test maps the rows its fixtures write itself (test/school_structure_rows.go) and adds CreateTestGradeTransitionHistory. The rules delivery-cutover.009, delivery-cutover.023 and workforce.adapter.school-structure-domain allowed only the removed imports and are deleted. No fallback provider, no second implementation, no route, status code, error text, authorization or tenant scope change.
